theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ) (x : Euclidean N) (f : C_c(Euclidean N, ℝ)) (r₀ a R r : ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) → (∀ y ∈ M, 0 ≤ θ y) → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ closedBall x r₀) μHE[n] → (∀ y, 0 ≤ f y) → (∀ y, f y ≤ 1) → (∀ y, ‖y‖ ≤ a → f y = 1) → (∀ y, R < ‖y‖ → f y = 0) → 0 < r → r * R ≤ r₀ → (((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict M).withDensity fun y ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (θ y)) (closedBall x (r * a)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n * ∫ y in Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M, f y * θ (x + r • y) ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n * ∫ y in Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M, f y * θ (x + r • y) ∂μHE[n]) ≤ (((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict M).withDensity fun y ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (θ y)) (closedBall x (r * R))
